sys_atf_test.description: Validates SnackFlow Invoice GST Calc (before/50) plus the pre-existing Invoice Total Calc (100) and reactivated Invoice Total Check (150). Inserts an invoice against the Tamil Nadu order so place_of_supply defaults to the customer state and asserts the intrastate split (gst_type=cgst_sgst, 5% of 10000 halved into CGST 250 + SGST 250, total 10500); then inserts an invoice against the Karnataka order with place_of_supply overridden to tamil_nadu and asserts the interstate case (gst_type=igst, IGST 500, CGST/SGST zero, total 10500). The 5% rate is resolved from the Murukku product master, never supplied by the test.
sys_atf_test.name: SnackFlow: GST calculation (intrastate CGST/SGST and interstate IGST)
